Forgotten Tomb

General Properties

Near city

Edron

Location

Near Stonehome, here (33313, 31718, 7).

Vocation(s)

All vocations.

Other Properties

Version

10.80
July 21, 2015
Summer Update 2015

See also: Hunting Places Help

The Forgotten Tomb is a place where undead roam, near Stonehome, here (33313, 31718, 7). It is the place where the great Ankrahmun vizier Mahatheb is buried along with his servants. Mahatheb the Vizier (Book) can be found in a Sarcophagus (Quest) here (33386, 31711, 13) in the room they are buried in.
